docs.title: Student Guide: Learning Differential Calculus
docs.text:
Welcome to your interactive guide to mathematical analysis!

How to use this guide

Interactive Mode: Type your answer in the box and press ENTER. If your answer is wrong, the solution will open automatically!

docs.title: 1. Practice Task
docs.text:
Consider the sequence \(a_n = \frac{n+1}{n}\). What is the limit as \(n \to \infty\)?

Your Answer (Press Enter):

Show Solution

Step-by-Step Calculation:

\[\lim_{n \to \infty} \left( 1 + \frac{1}{n} \right) = 1 + 0 = 1\]

docs.title: 2. Practice Task (The "Hole")
docs.text:
Compute the limit of \(f(x) = \frac{x^2 - 1}{x - 1}\) as \(x \to 1\).

Your Answer (Press Enter):

Show Solution

Factorize and simplify:

\[\lim_{x \to 1} (x+1) = 1+1 = 2\]

docs.title: 3. Practice Task
docs.text:
Compute the limit of \(f(x) = \frac{2x^2 - 2}{x - 1}\) as \(x \to 1\).

Your Answer (Press Enter):

Show Solution \[2(x^2-1) \to 2(x-1)(x+1) \to 2(1+1) = 4\]

docs.title: Task A: Sequence Limit
docs.text:
Find limit of \(a_n = \frac{3n}{n+2}\).

Show Solution

Divide by highest power (\(n\)):

\[\frac{3}{1 + 0} = 3\]

docs.title: Task B: Function Limit
docs.text:
Find limit of \(f(x) = \frac{x^2 + 3x}{x}\) as \(x \to 0\).

Show Solution

Factor out \(x\):

\[x(x+3)/x = 3\]

Good luck!
